name: ePub Generator: Viewer
description: In-browser epub.js reader for generated and uploaded ePubs, plus a response cache for generated ePubs.

suggests.futurepress/epubjs: The epub.js rendering library (0.3.93). Install to libraries/epubjs via an npm-tarball package repository; see the module README.
suggests.stuk/jszip: Required by epub.js to unpack ePub archives (3.10.1). Install to libraries/jszip via an npm-tarball package repository; see the module README.

project_description: The Viewer submodule of ePub Generator adds an in-browser ePub reader built on epub.js: a "Read online" tab beside "Download ePub" on nodes (opening the whole assembled book for Book nodes), an /epub/view/{entity_type}/{entity_id} route for other content entities, and an "ePub viewer (epub.js)" field formatter that renders uploaded .epub files inline. It also caches generated ePub bytes at the response level via a kernel event subscriber, so reading and repeated downloads do not regenerate the book each request; entries are keyed by route, parameters, query, content language and (by default) role combination, and invalidated by entity, book-outline, view-display and settings cache tags. The reader fetches books through the existing download routes, so their access checks apply on every request. Requires the base module and the epub.js and JSZip JavaScript libraries in the site libraries directory.
